verdict.rationale: Weave is a hosted LLM tracing and evaluation service that stores user inputs and outputs, so whether that data can be kept out of AI-model training is a fair privacy question for this kind of product. However, the evidence pack contains no data-usage policy, training opt-out, or no-training commitment. The tracing, cost, and guardrail material (including PII-detection scorers) is about other features and does not address model training on customer data.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
